installCommand: echo 'Flutter dependencies are installed during the build'
buildCommand: if [ ! -x "$HOME/flutter/bin/flutter" ]; then git clone --depth 1 --branch stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter"; fi && "$HOME/flutter/bin/flutter" config --no-analytics && "$HOME/flutter/bin/flutter" pub get && "$HOME/flutter/bin/flutter" build web --release
